payload.explanation: This log sequence is normal because it consists only of routine CE sym reports and a redundant-bit-steering activation, all tagged normal. The sequence shows 19 CE sym entries followed by the ddr entry activating redundant bit steering. No line is tagged abnormal, distinguishing this window from one containing an explicitly abnormal event.

This log sequence is normal because it consists only of routine machine-check i-fetch and store-operation events. Across the 20 entries, these records mostly alternate, with a few adjacent entries of the same type around lines 9–16. No line is tagged abnormal, distinguishing this window from one containing an abnormal-tagged event.

This log sequence is normal because all 20 entries are routine events: corrected torus and DDR errors, CE symbol reports, and tree-receiver re-synchronization events. The window begins with a corrected torus input-pipe event, continues with CE symbol and corrected DDR reports, and includes tree receiver re-synchronization reports before ending with a CE symbol report. No line is tagged abnormal; the reported errors are marked detected and corrected, and the remaining entries are normal-tagged reports.

No line is tagged abnormal; the torus and DDR reports state that their errors were detected and corrected, while the remaining entries are status or control records.
